speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Auriculotemporal Neuralgia (Secondary to Tympanoplasty). The combination of post-tympanoplasty status, shooting pain triggered by chewing (V3/V3-nerve stimulation), radiation to the temple, and the history of chronic ear infections strongly points to irritation or injury of the auriculotemporal nerve, likely due to graft placement or scarring. The resolved numbness suggests a transient nerve dysfunction rather than a complete transection.
